Hello {contact}, a gentle reminder that payment for bill {number} ({amount}, {date}) is pending. Please pay by UPI when convenient: {upi}. The bill is attached.
Thank you! — {business}

Hello {contact}. Payment for bill {number} ({amount}, {date}) has been due for {days} days. Please pay by UPI this week: {upi}. The bill is attached.
— {business}
remind.msg.second:
{contact}, following up once more: {number} ({amount}, {date}) is still unpaid. Let me know if there's any issue. UPI: {upi}. Bill attached again.
Thank you. — {business}
